summary: V1 implementation experiments: Pi SDK probing, fake stream seam, model tier classification, CLI fake-stream hook

tmp/pi-probe (probe.mjs/probe2.mjs): ModelRuntime.create with empty authPath/modelsPath returns getAvailable()=[]; createAgentSession requires a ResourceLoader implementation and accepts custom ToolDefinition echo tool; setRuntimeApiKey can fabricate auth for probing

Adopt pi-ai createFauxCore+createProvider as the scripted fake stream seam (packages/runtime-pi/src/testsupport.ts) instead of hand-rolling AssistantMessageEventStream protocol; faux provider gives signal-honoring streams, call recording and keyless auth

streamFunction wrap: session.agent.streamFunction is wrapped to inject options.maxTokens=min(policy.output.maxTokens, model.maxTokens); the '=== streamSimple' reference check inside pi-agent-core is bypassed because compaction is disabled via SettingsManager.inMemory
core model classification: 'mini' pattern anchored as /\bmini\b/ so 'gemini-2.5-pro' is not misclassified low; gemini-.*-pro stays medium (packages/core/src/model/classify.ts BUILTIN_TABLE)

CHEAPER_TEST_FAKE_STREAM hook design (PLAN-034r05iHy2gdnpJFiMWhkY): NODE_ENV=test guard in cli.ts; fixture default export = (ctx{modelRuntime}) => StreamFnLike (function registers fake provider itself) or scripted response array wrapped via @cheaper/runtime-pi/testsupport createFakePi + registerNativeProvider + refresh(allowNetwork:false)

e2e green: bulk-read success envelope via fake stream, cheap-write meta.changes measured non-empty, array fixture form accepted, NODE_ENV!=test ignores the env var (MODEL_TIER_UNAVAILABLE); 416 tests total
Adopted: faux-provider fake stream seam shared between runtime-pi tests and cli e2e; ModelRuntime factory kept inside runtime-pi so the cli never imports @earendil-works/* directly
